newsitem.title: FRANCE: SocGen says H2 will be less good than H1.
newsitem.headline: SocGen says H2 will be less good than H1.

text.p: Marc Vienot, the chairman of bank Societe Generale, said on Wednesday that the improvement of the banks' results would continue but the second half would be not as good as the first half.

He said that the first half, which saw the net attributable profit rise by 20.9 percent to 2.73 billion francs, was traditionally better than the first and he added that Societe Generale would be stretched to realise as many asset gains in the second half as it had done in the first.
"Do not multiply the first half results by two to get the full year. It is unlikely that we will match in the second half the rise of the first half," Vienot said.
"But it's a year which has not started badly. The third quarter is in line, we are within our budget. It's not bad, there is no weakening," he added.
